newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda Feb domestic vehicle output up 19.9% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Honda Feb domestic vehicle output up 19.9% yr/yr.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Friday that its domestic vehicle production, exports, domestic sales and overseas output in February rose as follows (with percentage comparisons from a year earlier):
Honda said domestic production rose in February for an eighth consecutive month on a year-on-year basis, mainly helped by higher exports.

Honda's domestic sales in February rose for a 26th successive month on a year-on-year basis, due to robust demand for its recreational vehicle series -- Step Wagon, S-MX and Odyssey, new Logo compact hatchback, and Prelude sports car.
Its exports rose for the sixth month in a row, helped by the start of shipments of the CR-V light sports-utility vehicle to North America in January this year.
Overseas production rose for a 13th consecutive month due to higher output in North America and Asia, it said.
